title: Citadel of Ricks — Master Schematic Database
generated_from: Evidence registers in this repository (see SCHEMATIC.md for derivation rules)

units.U: 1 U = radius of the principal transparent dome (DOME-P). All lengths are dimensionless multiples of U.
units.absolute_conversion_note: Leave null until a scale anchor is justified from reference images (see scale_anchors). When set, absolute_metres = value_in_U * absolute_conversion.

coordinate_system.origin: Centre of DOME-P at the surface-city ground plane
coordinate_system.x: horizontal; +X = 'east' (used only for the East Sanchez Heights name-inference, confidence C)
coordinate_system.y: horizontal; +Y = 90 deg counter-clockwise from +X viewed from above
coordinate_system.z: Citadel vertical axis; +Z up (towards dome apex), -Z down into the lower metallic body
coordinate_system.azimuth: degrees, measured counter-clockwise from +X when viewed from +Z

placement_classes.LOCKED: Existence A and geometry directly supported. Do not move without new direct evidence.
placement_classes.ANCHORED: Existence A; position follows from an explicit source relationship (e.g. 'central plaza'). Move only if a frame contradicts it.
placement_classes.PROVISIONAL: Existence A/B; position is a reasoned inference (C). Expected to move once images are camera-matched.
placement_classes.PLACEHOLDER: Existence A/B/C; position is arbitrary (D) and exists only so the node has a slot in the model. Must be re-placed from images.
placement_classes.UNPLACED: Not given coordinates. Comic-only, prop-scatter, or no spatial evidence at all.

geometry_layers.L0: Global station shell (lower metallic body, plates, hull underside)
geometry_layers.L2: Primary streets, rail, tram, hover band, portal and underground access
geometry_layers.L4: Landmark buildings, complexes and their key interiors
geometry_layers.L7: Underground machinery, interfaces, destruction and reconstruction variants

nodes.name: Lower metallic structural body
nodes.rationale: Repeated exterior views show a lower metallic mass much larger than the upper city. Taper and depth are provisional envelope values chosen so all underground bands fit inside.

nodes.name: Exterior structural plates
nodes.rationale: Plates exist (A). Count of 12 is a modelling placeholder so the exterior reads as segmented; re-count from exterior frames.

nodes.name: Hull underside with exit aperture
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (spacecraft launched from the bottom of the Citadel)
nodes.rationale: The exit chute launches from the bottom; therefore the hull underside has an aperture on the chute axis (UG-EXIT-CHUTE).

nodes.name: Principal transparent dome
nodes.rationale: Strongest recurring exterior feature. Defines the unit U and the origin.
unknowns: exact dome profile (full hemisphere vs. shallower cap)

nodes.name: Secondary dome 1
nodes.rationale: Secondary domes exist; three is the secondary-source count. Equal spacing at 120 deg is a placeholder. District assignment UNKNOWN.
unknowns: whether it sits on the rim or projects from the lower body

nodes.name: Secondary dome 2
nodes.rationale: See DOME-S1.

nodes.name: Mortyburg dome (detachable section)
nodes.rationale: Mortyburg is a smaller domed section that physically separates (A). Working hypothesis: it is one of the three secondary domes (C). Placed on the rim because it must have an exterior face to detach through. Azimuth is placeholder. In DS-06 it is stranded separately (see EPISODE_EVIDENCE_SOLARICKS.md) — render it displaced from the debris field.
unknowns: whether Mortyburg is one of the 'three' domes or a fourth

nodes.name: Inner circumferential road
nodes.rationale: Several views show circular organisation. Three rings is a modelling convention, not a count from any frame.

nodes.name: Middle circumferential road
nodes.rationale: See CIRC-RING-1.

nodes.name: Outer circumferential road
nodes.rationale: See CIRC-RING-1.

nodes.name: Radial avenues (8)
nodes.rationale: Radial organisation is supported (B); eight is a modelling convention.

nodes.name: Fifth and [Burp] Avenue intersection
nodes.rationale: Named intersection associated with Mortytown by dispatch; placed where CIRC-RING-2 meets the 225 deg radial, inside DIST-MORTYTOWN.

nodes.name: Commuter rail loop
nodes.rationale: A commuter train exists (A). A loop at z=+0.05 is a placeholder topology chosen so it can connect the plaza tramway to the Mortyburg spur; elevation is UNKNOWN (ground/elevated/underground all possible).
unknowns: whether the S03E07 train and S05E10 tram are the same system

nodes.name: Rail spur to Mortyburg
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (train route connecting affected area to Mortyburg)
nodes.rationale: Route exists and passes through the Mortyburg interface (A). Path is a straight provisional connector from the loop to IF-MORTYBURG.
unknowns: whether the spur is the same track as the loop

nodes.name: Plaza tramway
nodes.rationale: Tramway is shown in the same flooding sequence as the central plaza; therefore anchored adjacent to LM-CENTRAL-PLAZA. Direction is placeholder; drawn to meet CIRC-RAIL-LOOP.

nodes.name: Hover / flying traffic band
nodes.rationale: Flying taxis and private flying cars exist (A). Band limits are a placeholder envelope for the 3D model's traffic layer.
required_shots: S03E07 city montage with flying cars
S03E07 taxi pickup at Cafe Sanchez

nodes.name: Manhole / sewer access near plaza
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (manhole used by Rick and Morty)
nodes.rationale: Used during the plaza/tramway flooding sequence, so it sits at the plaza edge.

nodes.name: Citywide portal supply network
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (citywide portal supply can be hacked)
nodes.rationale: Exists as a system; no visible routing. Kept as a separate ID from UG-PORTAL-FLUID and UG-DIM-DRIVE per C-006.

nodes.name: Hover taxi service
nodes.rationale: Curbside pickup behaviour is direct evidence; vehicles are props on CIRC-HOVER-BAND / streets, not a placed structure.

nodes.name: Civic / government core
nodes.rationale: The central plaza and the Presidential Building are shown together in the collapse; government functions cluster around the plaza. Council Hall, courthouse and Morty Agency are placed here as PROVISIONAL/PLACEHOLDER, not because a frame shows them adjacent.
unknowns: which civic buildings are actually here

nodes.name: Commercial / high-rise ring
nodes.rationale: Dense high-rise blocks with storefronts, cafes and the newsroom. Ring placement is a convention: densest fabric between the civic core and the outer districts.

nodes.name: High-status Rick residential
evidence: RICKLANTIS_VISUAL_EVIDENCE.md 2 (wealthy Rick in private flying car)
nodes.rationale: Stratification is documented; a distinct wealthy residential area is inferred, not shown as a district. Placed opposite Mortytown to express the contrast.
unknowns: whether a discrete district exists at all

nodes.name: East Sanchez Heights
nodes.rationale: Named subdivision (A). Placed on +X solely because of the word 'East' (C); 'Heights' suggests elevated terrain or towers (D).
unknowns: whether 'East' refers to Citadel geometry at all

nodes.name: Industrial sector
nodes.rationale: Simple Rick's and the Wishing Portal compound need large floor plates; grouped at the rim so heavy machinery can connect down to the lower body.
unknowns: whether industry is one sector or distributed

nodes.name: Mortytown
nodes.rationale: Distinct neighbourhood with streets, alleys, Morty Mart, Creepy Morty, occupied residences (A). Placed at the rim on a lower-status/edge inference (C). NOT the same thing as Mortyburg (C-003) — the sector is adjacent to the Mortyburg interface only as a modelling convenience.

nodes.name: Big Morty criminal territory
nodes.rationale: Criminal economy is shown inside Mortytown; the sub-sector is arbitrary.

nodes.name: Agricultural edge (MegaFruit farm)
nodes.rationale: Open agricultural land distinct from dense streets, previously identified as farm-at-edge; therefore an outer sector under the dome where open space reads correctly.
required_shots: S03E07 Farmer Rick and robot dog

nodes.name: Post-Rickshank construction zones
nodes.rationale: Damaged buildings and roadways with active skyscraper reconstruction (A). Where the damage was is UNKNOWN; the sector is arbitrary. In the 3D model this is a state-dependent overlay, not a permanent district.

nodes.name: Downtown Rickville (comic)
nodes.rationale: Comic-only location. Per C-008 it is not given animated-continuity coordinates.

nodes.name: Central plaza
nodes.rationale: Described as central; anchored on the origin. Whether the same plaza exists in DS-01..03 is UNKNOWN, so states are limited to S05E10.

nodes.name: Presidential Building
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (Rick and Morty exit it during the collapse)
nodes.rationale: Exited into the collapse sequence that also shows the plaza; placed on the plaza edge. Tallest civic mass by convention.

nodes.name: Council Hall (Council of Ricks)
nodes.rationale: Council chamber with stage/seating is direct (A). Its exterior and its position relative to the later Presidential Building are UNKNOWN. Placed in the civic core. States end at DS-02 because the Council is destroyed in Rickshank; whether the building persists is UNKNOWN.

nodes.name: Council chamber (interior)
nodes.rationale: Interior arrangement is visible; the six-member Council gives the seat count.

nodes.name: Shadow Council Hall
nodes.rationale: Dedicated interior with designated seats (A). Not proven to be the old Council Hall; kept as a separate node in the civic core.

nodes.name: Courthouse / judicial facility
nodes.rationale: Judicial function exists; no building shown. Civic-core slot.

nodes.name: Morty Agency
nodes.rationale: Administrative facility with controlled access (A/B). Placed in the civic core as an administrative function; adjacency to anything is explicitly NOT established.

nodes.name: Citadel militia / SEAL Team Ricks base
evidence: CITADEL_POLICE.md (Council era militia, SEAL Team Ricks)
nodes.rationale: Council-era security force exists; the facility is inferred. Near the civic core for government access.
unknowns: whether it is the same site as LM-POLICE-HQ in later states

nodes.name: Citadel Police HQ and Academy
nodes.rationale: Police patrol Mortytown and dispatch to 'Fifth and Burp'; HQ placed between the civic core and Mortytown so patrol routes are short. Integrated into the street network per CITADEL_POLICE.md.
unknowns: whether HQ and Academy are one building

nodes.name: Police Academy shooting range
nodes.rationale: Directly shown interior.

nodes.name: Morty Academy

nodes.name: Simple Rick's Wafer Cookie Factory

nodes.name: Wishing Portal compound
nodes.rationale: Rusty building inside a tall circular wall with a gated entrance (A). It is a waste-disposal facility; grouped with industry at the rim. The portal pit is assumed to drop into V-1/V-2.
unknowns: whether the Waste Disposal Plant is this site (kept separate as LM-WASTE-PLANT)

nodes.name: Waste Disposal Plant
nodes.rationale: Named in secondary sources; placed next to the Wishing Portal because both are waste infrastructure. Not proven to be the same site.

nodes.name: Body-disposal airlock pods
nodes.rationale: Pods expel bodies into space, so they must penetrate the outer hull. Placed on the rim beside the waste facilities (C). Separate system from the Wishing Portal per the evidence register.
unknowns: whether they are on the dome rim or the lower body

nodes.name: Street furniture, signage, trees, fountains
nodes.rationale: Catalogue per frame; scatter procedurally in the 3D model.

nodes.name: Sewer / utility passages
nodes.rationale: Person-sized passages exist (A). Routing under the road network is a modelling convention.

nodes.name: Portal-fluid production complex ('cave base')
nodes.rationale: Reached by descending from the city; described as a cave base with a large central vat (A). Offset from the axis so it does not collide with UG-DIM-DRIVE; the offset direction is arbitrary.

nodes.name: Dimensional Drive chamber
nodes.rationale: Secondary sources describe the Drive as central; its failure deforms the whole Citadel, consistent with a central position. Anchored on the axis below the civic core.

nodes.name: Glass-domed control enclosure
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (glass-domed/control enclosure around the principal control interface)
nodes.rationale: Directly described; placed on a platform at the chamber edge overlooking the core.

nodes.name: Operation Phoenix vats
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (Operation Phoenix vats feed biological material into the drive process)
nodes.rationale: Vats feed the Drive, so they ring the core. Count of six is placeholder.

nodes.name: Launch chamber (Evil Morty's spacecraft)
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (spacecraft loaded into an exit chute)
nodes.rationale: The spacecraft is loaded from the Drive area into the chute; the chamber therefore sits between the Drive and the chute. Survives as RUIN-LAUNCH-CHAMBER in DS-06.

nodes.name: Spacecraft exit chute
evidence: EPISODE_EVIDENCE_RICKMURAI_JACK.md (launched from the bottom of the Citadel)
nodes.rationale: Vertical chute from the launch chamber to SHELL-UNDERSIDE. Axis shares the launch chamber's offset; the SHELL-UNDERSIDE aperture follows it.

nodes.name: Mortyburg attachment interface
nodes.rationale: Engineered structural/transit interface with a closing entrance (A). Sits on the DOME-P rim at the Mortyburg azimuth, on the rail spur.

nodes.name: Mortyburg boosters / thrusters
nodes.rationale: Thrusters fire after separation (A); on the underside by convention.

nodes.name: Post-destruction debris field
nodes.rationale: Large spatially coherent ruin exposed to vacuum, with distinct fragments. Radius is a placeholder for the fragment scatter.

nodes.name: Ruined launch chamber
nodes.rationale: Same envelope as UG-LAUNCH-CHAMBER, ruin variant. Whether the fragment kept its original position is UNKNOWN (C-009).

nodes.name: Summer's beacon on the ruins
nodes.rationale: Navigation target on an exposed ruin surface.

nodes.name: New Citadel construction (Boss Hog Rick)
nodes.rationale: Separate architecture reusing wreckage; NOT a restoration of the original geometry (C-010). Envelope placed over part of the debris field.
